rows.text: INFORMATION FROM THE MEETING OF THE MONETARY POLICY
The Council decided to increase the NBP interest rates by 0.25 percentage point to the level: • reference rate 4.50 % on an annual basis;
The Polish economy is still in the period of strong growth encompassing all its sectors.
The economic activity should be sustained for at least next few quarters, even though economic growth economic growth in Poland will be supported by strong activity in the world economy and,
In May the annual growth of consumer prices in Poland amounted to 2.3%, and hence it was close to the NBP's inflation target of 2.5% for another consecutive month.
In the Council's assessment in 2007 Q3 inflation may temporarily fall below its present
In the Council's assessment, in the next quarters economic growth will most probably continue to exceed the growth of potential GDP.
The latest information on labour market developments points to a continuation of high wage growth and a deterioration in the relation between wage and labour productivity growth.
A further build-up of wage pressure and, consequently, inflationary pressure is possible.

The Council assessed that in the medium term inflation increase may be constrained by a continuation of high productivity growth, very good financial results of enterprises and still low growth of external prices, related to globalisation and
inflation at the target level over the monetary policy transmission horizon.

Therefore, the Council assessed the probability of inflation running above the inflation target in the medium term to be higher than the probability of inflation running below the target and decided to increase the NBP

In the coming months, the Council will be closely monitoring the growth and the structure of domestic demand, including the degree of the expansionary fiscal policy stance, the relation between wage and labour productivity growth, zloty exchange rate and the impact of globalisation
